references.text: Previous verse describing the priest's atonement for the congregation of Israel for unintentional sins
Same principle of forgiveness after a sin offering for unintentional sins committed by the congregation
Parallel text about forgiveness after atonement for sins committed in ignorance
Promise of forgiveness after a sin offering for an unintentional sin
The same law applies to Israelites and foreigners living among them regarding unintentional sins
The principle of one law for the native-born and the foreigner living among them
Atonement for the entire congregation of Israel
Forgiveness for sins committed in ignorance (בִּשְׁגָגָה)
The high priest brings an offering for the people's sins committed in ignorance, pointing to Christ's perfect sacrifice
